chunks: What al-Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, informed me of, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام.
Concerning the cat: it is of the household, and wudu (ablution) may be performed with its leftover water.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ: the household; here indicating domestic familiarity and tolerated presence

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform wudu (ablution) with water left over by a cat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding ritual purity and the cat’s leftover water. Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام states that the cat is considered among the household, and that wudu (ablution) may be performed using water from which it has drunk.
